notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only Umbra's Query Attribute Ownership and matching federate-owned/unowned report path in the non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 development profile. It uses only candidate records exported by the Requirements Lab and does not infer missing IDs. The implementation validates the requester's known instance/class boundary, groups attributes by a joined federate owner or available-for-acquisition result, dispatches the corresponding official C++ callbacks, and nullifies queued ownership reports once Remove Object Instance has begun. It deliberately does not synthesize an RTI-owned result because no implemented ownership service can establish that standard state. Ownership acquisition/divestiture, RTI-owned state, resign-action ownership disposition, timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM, FOM sharing policy, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice. The linked Catch2 test demonstrates a bounded implementation slice, not full IEEE 1516.1-2025 conformance.
